description: Runs every check in one framework against a single record and returns a scorecard: how many passed and failed, each failing control with its reason, and a receipt for every result. Use it for a quick readiness view, e.g. framework=euaiact with the deployment's governance record. Nothing is stored.

framework.description: Framework key from sebbi_find_checks, e.g. euaiact.

record.description: The governance or decision record (framework checks).

name: sebbi_run_framework
title: Run a whole framework
